skills.name: cognicode-discover
skills.description: Discover the CogniCode capabilities available in a workspace: which tools are exposed, what they cover, and which stability tier each one belongs to. Use this before any code-analysis question so the agent can answer 'what can I do here' from the catalog, not from guesses.

skills.name: cognicode-navigate
skills.description: Resolve a symbol to its code, find where it is used, and trace references across the workspace. Use this when the agent must answer 'where is X defined', 'who calls X', or 'which file holds symbol Y'.

skills.name: cognicode-quality
skills.description: Surface quality findings (god functions, long parameter lists, complexity hotspots, SOLID audits) so the agent can answer 'what is wrong with this code' from the catalog of normalized findings.

skills.name: cognicode-refactor
skills.description: Preview a safe refactor without mutating the workspace: the preview shows what would change, per-file, with the workspace state digest an authorized apply would later check.
